svg.text: SOLVER — a stock Claude Code session
unmodified · keeps its own tools (Bash, Edit, …) · never told what to prove
every seat reads it; only these two write it
identical text ⇒ one node · verdicts transfer free
no count cap — every obligation is verified
a claim's status = the fold of
one refuted node ⇒ refuted, and its
blocked by an unobtainable tool ⇒ partial
KERNEL — verifies one claim at a time
trigger — a claim is verified the moment it is committed, before anything leans on it
compiles each claim into its world-checkable obligations · sees the graph, never the argument
residual on verified premises · reuses proven statements verbatim · no count cap
refuted ⇒ short-circuit with a witness · exhausted ⇒ failed · faithful ⇒ bound
obligation · attack · instrument patterns → the compiler & oracle prompt slots · never a verdict, never a gate
CERTIFICATE — the final claim's slice, frozen
each claim entry nests its obligation nodes with their evidence · assurance levels disclosed · returned over MCP
verdict = the worst case over the slice — refuted > unverified/stale > partial > verified · never rounds up
merges only on a verified certificate (exit 0)
